{{Top|leg}}
A '''shoulder-launched ion cannon''' was a personal [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] designed to act as an anti-vehicle [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] weapon. It had a range of up to three hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and had to be hook up to a [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] to fire.
